Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 10343 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-05–2026-07), queried against Hackney's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 3.5072 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (135% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 17.4641 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (135% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 237,949 (2021 resident population of 259,100, scaled by a density-based proxy resident-vs-workday ratio from the ONS's 2011 Census release for Hackney — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Frequently asked questions

Is Hackney safe?

Based on real, current UK Police data, Wandroz rates Hackney as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in London during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in London at night, relative to the other London boroughs currently on the automated pipeline. The rating comes from 10343 recorded incidents over 3 months (2026-05 to 2026-07), split into a day-weighted score (property crime) and a night-weighted score (violence, robbery, antisocial behaviour).

Is Hackney safe at night?

Hackney's night score is an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in London, based on the categories most relevant after dark (violence, robbery, street theft, public order, antisocial behaviour), normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population rather than plain residents where that data exists, so busy central boroughs aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents.

What official data is Hackney's rating based on?

10343 recorded incidents from data.police.uk (the UK Police's official open crime API), queried against Hackney's real administrative boundary and covering 3 months (2026-05 to 2026-07) — recomputed from the source data whenever the Met publishes new months, not a one-off snapshot. Full category breakdown is shown further down this page.
